decisions.rationale: After exhaustive comparison against all 219 comparators, PF-0189 is merge-equivalent: both observations govern the same sensitive local debug-capture evidence exception, its authorization and redaction boundary, retention/deletion/export lifecycle, user privacy outcome, persisted-evidence state boundary, and fail-safe behavior. The related refs address neighboring privacy or evidence contracts with different records, consumers, or lifecycle boundaries.
